> **Department**: Enterprise Architecture Practice

page_texts.2:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#position-summary]

## Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Lead Enterprise Architect to lead our Enterprise Architecture Practice (EAP) and drive the strategic technology vision for Gainwell Technologies. This executive role will establish and govern the Enterprise Reference Architecture (ERA) across the entire product portfolio, ensure alignment with business strategy, and position the company as a leader in healthcare technology innovation.

---
page_texts.4:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#strategic-leadership]

### Strategic Leadership

- Define and execute the enterprise-wide architecture strategy aligned with business objectives
- Lead the Enterprise Architecture Practice and establish architectural governance across all business units
- Drive technology transformation initiatives that support organizational growth and competitive advantage
- Represent architecture strategy to executive leadership, board members, and external stakeholders
page_texts.5:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#architecture-governance]

### Architecture Governance

- Establish and maintain the Enterprise Reference Architecture (ERA) framework and standards
- Lead the Architecture Review Board (ARB) and enterprise governance processes
- Ensure architectural alignment across Business, Application, Information, Infrastructure Technology, Service Management, and Security domains
- Drive architectural compliance and exception management processes
page_texts.6:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#organizational-leadership]

### Organizational Leadership

- Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Enterprise Architecture Practice team
- Establish architecture career development paths and competency frameworks
- Drive architectural culture change and adoption across the organization
- Mentor and develop senior architects and architectural leaders
page_texts.7:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#technology-strategy]

### Technology Strategy

- Evaluate and guide adoption of emerging technologies and industry trends
- Lead technology vendor relationships and strategic partnerships
- Drive cloud-first architecture strategy across AWS and Azure platforms
- Establish technology standards and platforms that enable business agility
page_texts.8:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#business-partnership]

### Business Partnership

- Partner with C-level executives on technology strategy and digital transformation
- Lead architectural support for major business initiatives and acquisitions
- Ensure architecture strategy supports business growth, scalability, and market expansion
- Drive alignment between technology investment and business value
page_texts.9:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#industry-leadership]

### Industry Leadership

- Represent Gainwell Technologies as a thought leader in healthcare technology architecture
- Participate in industry standards bodies and healthcare technology consortiums
- Drive innovation in healthcare interoperability and compliance (HIPAA, MITA, FedRAMP)
- Establish Gainwell as a leader in enterprise architecture practices

---
page_texts.11:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#education]

### Education

- **Minimum**: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field
- **Preferred**: Master's degree in relevant technical field or MBA with technology focus
page_texts.12:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#experience]

### Experience

- **Required**: 15+ years of experience in enterprise architecture and technology leadership
- **Required**: 5+ years in executive or senior leadership roles
- **Required**: 7+ years of experience in healthcare technology or government systems
- **Preferred**: Experience leading enterprise transformation initiatives
page_texts.13:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#leadership-experience]

### Leadership Experience

- **Required**: Experience building and leading large, distributed technical teams (50+ people)
- **Required**: Executive-level communication and presentation skills
- **Required**: Experience with P&L responsibility and budget management
- **Preferred**: Experience with merger and acquisition technology integration
page_texts.15:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#executive-architecture-skills]

#### Executive Architecture Skills

- Advanced expertise in enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman, FEAF)
- Strategic technology planning and roadmap development
- Enterprise architecture governance and compliance management
- Technology portfolio management and rationalization
page_texts.16:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#technology-leadership]

#### Technology Leadership

- Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and cloud transformation
- Advanced understanding of healthcare technology ecosystems
- Enterprise security architecture and compliance frameworks
- Modern software architecture patterns and technology trends
page_texts.17:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#industry-expertise]

#### Industry Expertise

- Deep knowledge of healthcare regulations (HIPAA, MITA, FedRAMP, FISMA)
- Understanding of government healthcare programs and compliance requirements
- Experience with Health and Human Services interoperability standards (X12 EDI, NCPDP, FHIR, IX4HS, NIEM)
- Knowledge of Medicaid systems and state government technology
page_texts.18:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#documentation--ai-tools]

#### Documentation & AI Tools

- Markdown and documentation-as-code practices for technical documentation
- Experience with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Amazon CodeWhisperer, etc.)
- Generative AI tools for strategic architecture planning and innovation
- AI agents and automation tools for enterprise transformation and governance
page_texts.20:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#required]

#### Required

- TOGAF 9 Certified Master or equivalent enterprise architecture certification
page_texts.21:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#preferred]

#### Preferred

- AWS Solutions Architect Professional or Azure Solutions Architect Expert
- Executive leadership or management certification
- Industry-specific certifications (healthcare, government)

---
page_texts.23:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#executive-experience]

### Executive Experience

- Experience in healthcare technology or government contracting organizations
- Background in digital transformation and organizational change management
- Experience with regulatory compliance and audit processes
- Track record of successful technology M&A integration
page_texts.24:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#thought-leadership--industry-recognition]

### Thought Leadership & Industry Recognition

- Recognized thought leadership in enterprise architecture or healthcare technology
- Speaking experience at major industry conferences and events
- Published articles or research in relevant technology domains
- Participation in industry standards bodies or advisory groups
page_texts.25:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#strategic-capabilities]

### Strategic Capabilities

- Experience developing and executing multi-year technology strategies
- Background in technology investment and portfolio management
- Experience with venture capital or private equity technology due diligence
- International technology and architecture experience
- Experience with Generative AI strategy and implementation in enterprise environments

---
page_texts.27:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#executive-leadership]

### Executive Leadership

- **Visionary Thinking**: Ability to develop and communicate compelling technology vision
- **Strategic Planning**: Expertise in long-term strategic planning and execution
- **Organizational Development**: Skills in building and scaling high-performance teams
- **Change Leadership**: Experience leading large-scale organizational transformation
page_texts.28:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#technical-leadership]

### Technical Leadership

- **Architecture Mastery**: Deep expertise across all architecture domains
- **Technology Innovation**: Ability to identify and leverage emerging technologies
- **Systems Integration**: Experience with complex enterprise system integration
- **Risk Management**: Expertise in technology risk assessment and mitigation
page_texts.29:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#business-acumen]

### Business Acumen

- **Financial Management**: Understanding of technology ROI and business value
- **Market Awareness**: Knowledge of competitive landscape and industry trends
- **Stakeholder Management**: Ability to influence and align diverse stakeholder groups
- **Customer Focus**: Understanding of customer needs and market requirements
page_texts.30:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#communication--influence]

### Communication & Influence

- **Executive Presence**: Ability to command respect and influence at all organizational levels
- **Public Speaking**: Excellent presentation and public speaking abilities
- **Thought Leadership**: Capability to represent organization as industry expert
- **Cross-functional Collaboration**: Skills in working across diverse business functions

---
page_texts.32:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#year-one-objectives]

### Year One Objectives

- Establish comprehensive Enterprise Reference Architecture (ERA) framework
- Build and structure the Enterprise Architecture Practice team
- Implement architecture governance processes and ARB
- Complete assessment and roadmap for current state architecture
page_texts.33:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/lead-enterprise-architect.md#ongoing-responsibilities]

### Ongoing Responsibilities

- Maintain architecture alignment with business strategy and objectives
- Drive measurable improvements in technology delivery speed and quality
- Ensure compliance with all healthcare and government regulations
- Establish Gainwell as recognized leader in healthcare enterprise architecture
